answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 36322 Country: Pakistan Title: What is sunnah way of doing istinja passing nijasah Question: What is sunnah way of doing istinja passing nijasah? I have read in Ma'ariful Hadith that the holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) would take some stones with him to do istinja then he wash with water. So by doing istinja with water we have to touch our private part especially by passing urine. Answer ID: 36322 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 265/153/D=1433) If one needs to use hands then one should use left hand. It is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
